Experience world-class luxury, one on one private mental health retreats expertly designed for our USA clients seeking a personalised mental and emotional wellbeing retreat with life changing results
Alive Luxury Retreats is not a typical retreat. It is a private, luxury sanctuary for real transformation.
If you are searching for a mental health retreat in the USA, you are likely ready for more than surface level support. You are ready for something that actually works.

At our luxury private mental health retreats, everything is delivered one on one, fully personalised, and completely confidential. This is a five star, high end experience designed for those who expect the highest level of care, privacy, and results.

Since 2009, we have guided clients through our proven 360 degree holistic process, working across your mental, emotional, and physical wellbeing together. This is not a single therapy or short term fix. It is a complete system designed to create lasting change in how you think, feel, and live.

Many guests from the United States travel to experience this level of private, luxury mental health care, choosing a retreat that offers more depth, more support, and more personalised attention than traditional options.

Your program may focus on 360 degree health transformation, customised private detox, burnout, anxiety, depression, or emotional overwhelm, but it is always tailored entirely to you. Delivered by your own dedicated expert team, your experience combines advanced therapy, coaching, nervous system support, and holistic healing, all working together to create powerful, life changing results.
This is where you step out of everything that has been building. Where your mind becomes clear again. Where you reconnect with yourself at a deeper level.
A world class, private luxury mental health retreat designed to help you reset properly, rebuild your strength, and return to life clear, steady, and fully in control again.
